title: Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rava’s student, as in Berakhot 24a, where he said: “Once I was standing before Rava, and he said to me, ‘Go bring me tefillin’ — to teach us a practical halakhah.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef.
